profile.name: OSSR
profile.about:
Open-source Stacks transaction sponsorship relay. Send sBTC without holding STX: relay operators pay network fees in STX and receive atomic reimbursement in sats. Stacks testnet prototype. Built for the plebs.

Code: https://github.com/ossr-protocol/ossr
Docs: https://github.com/ossr-protocol/ossr#readme
Run a relay: https://github.com/ossr-protocol/ossr/tree/main/apps/operator
